name: @livekit/blingfire
description: BlingFire bindings for livekit-agents (sentence / word tokenization)
author: LiveKit

scripts.//install: No-op to suppress pnpm 9's implicit `node-gyp rebuild` (pnpm ignores `gypfile: false`).
scripts.prebuild-blingfire: cmake -S ../core -B .blingfire-build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DLK_BLINGFIRE_STATIC_CRT=ON && cmake --build .blingfire-build --target lk_blingfire_core --config Release --parallel && cmake --install .blingfire-build --component lk_blingfire --config Release --prefix .blingfire-prebuilt
scripts.build:dev: pnpm prebuild-blingfire && node-gyp rebuild && node test/smoke.js
scripts.prebuildify: pnpm prebuild-blingfire && prebuildify --napi --strip --target node@18.0.0 && node test/smoke.js
